description: Four low frequency oscillators, each with a sine, a triangle, a saw and a square output, and five modes that link them together

params.text: Steps through the five modes and returns to the first after the last, setting all four oscillators back to the start of their cycle each time; the lit lamp of the five shows which mode is set
Sets the rate of the first oscillator, one cycle in 32 seconds at the bottom to 32 cycles a second at the top, and in every mode but the first it sets the rate for all four
Sets that oscillator's own rate in the first mode, its phase against the first oscillator in the third, and a whole number from 1 to 12 in the fourth and fifth; it changes nothing in the second

inputs.text: Raises the first oscillator's rate by an octave per volt on top of its slider, and in every mode but the first it does that for all four
Raises that oscillator's rate by an octave per volt on top of its slider, and is read only in the first mode
Sets the first oscillator back to the start of its cycle on each rising edge above 1V, and in every mode but the first it does that for all four
Sets that oscillator back to the start of its cycle on each rising edge above 1V, and is read only in the first mode

outputs.text: A sine wave from that oscillator, -5V to 5V
A triangle wave from that oscillator, -5V to 5V
A rising saw from that oscillator, -5V to 5V
A square wave from that oscillator, -5V or 5V with an even half of the cycle at each

notes: the first three modes are: every oscillator on its own; four quarter-cycle phases of one oscillator; and one oscillator with the phases of the other three set by their sliders
the fourth and fifth modes run the first oscillator and derive the other three from it, dividing or multiplying its rate by the whole number each of their sliders sets
the mode is saved with the patch
